changes: Separate successful order archive/restore results from follow-up read failures and block mutations against stale lists.
Retain unfinished bulk archive selections and require exact confirmed test-order identity.
Introduce actor-scoped finance transaction replay keys using the existing idempotency_records table, with payload conflict checks and transactional audit recording.
Use a dedicated idempotent finance POST route so old API deployments reject new clients instead of silently accepting a duplicate-prone fallback.
Preserve unresolved collection/expense submissions and retry their original body and key; freeze the corresponding input form until resolved.
Make the incoming-transfer entry grid responsive instead of requiring a 1080px-wide form.

verification.database_scope: Synthetic isolated PostgreSQL-compatible database; test adapter serializes transactions. Production retry serialization uses the asserted PostgreSQL advisory lock.

limitations: Uncertain-submission recovery is in memory for the current screen session. After closing or reloading the page, review existing financial records before entering a new transaction.
Idempotency keys deduplicate retries by the same actor, not separate employees entering the same bank transaction with different keys.
manual_checks_pending: Browser layout review of responsive finance entry and archive controls.
Designated test-account checks after API and panel deployment.
